invariants.rationale: Option implementations should be non-null unless the method explicitly returns null.
context is required to construct the CleanPlanActionExecutor and thus must not be null at method exit.
result is the direct output of CleanPlanActionExecutor.execute(), so their present-ness is equal.
If extraMetadata is present, its contained Map should be non-null.
result is always the result of calling execute() on a new CleanPlanActionExecutor instantiated with the inputs.
